description: A shell script used for testing the gitweb interface from the command line. It performs various tests on a git repository, including checking project summaries, commits, diffs, tags, logs, and other features of the gitweb web interface. The script sets up repositories, makes commits, and runs a series of test commands to validate gitweb functionalities, with related configurations and external script sourcing.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Function used to execute the gitweb interface with specific parameters for testing.
